title: Let worth be received in truth
summary: This meets the fragile self that borrows dignity from reaction and approval. The line says those attuned to Truth are absorbed into what is most real, not into what others say.
takeaway: Receive dignity from Truth, not applause.
lifeApplication: Before defending your worth, stop and feel how much of it you are outsourcing. Let attunement to Truth arrive before the room's response does.

source.shortMeaning: Worth steadies when the heart is attuned to Truth itself.
source.lifeApplication: When worth feels borrowed, return it to Truth before you defend it.

evidence.coreClaim: Worth steadies when the heart is attuned to Truth itself.
evidence.turn: Let Truth, not applause, give the heart its place.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before defending your worth, stop and feel how much of it you are outsourcing. Let attunement to Truth arrive before the room's response does.
